source_class: user physical measurements of visible-LCD offsets from front-glass edges
required_recheck: Re-measure visible LCD height directly, preferably with caliper jaws on the visible active window.
Alternatively re-measure T and B from the same glass reference edges used for the 75.00 mm total height.
Vertical production datum closes when T + visible_height + B equals 75.00 mm within measurement tolerance.
do_not_infer: Do not average T/B or silently force centered margins.
Do not change the measured 3 mm / 7 mm values merely to match the prior 66 mm visible-height reading.
